notes.title: Update #1: Companion with a spark
notes.content:
Hello, love seekers. It's time to bring you the first update. Of course, where would we be without it? You haven't found Hitler yet? It's about time, he's waiting. And in the meantime, I've brought you an update, not a simple one, but a furry one.

[h3]So, what did your favorite Developer of the Year bring you? I'll tell you now:[/h3]

[b]Meow! Who are you?[/b]
Now the second level begins with a nice companion who will accompany you in full love and understanding and sometimes chat with you.

As soon as you load, the game will immediately display your nickname in the greeting and in (for now) one dialogue.

[b]Fire, grass and everything that could go wrong[/b]
Did you decide that the game wasn't green enough? I added grass to the location, and then, to make it less cute, I threw a couple of lights on the equipment. Yes, they just burn. Why? I don't know either. But now the world has become a little more fiery and slightly burning.

[b]Companion cat: because you can't do it alone[/b]
Your new feline friend! Every time she will appear next to you, run after you and throw out phrases so meaningless that you will think: "Maybe it's not me who is looking for Hitler?" Perhaps the cat has hidden knowledge, perhaps she is just here for the sake of your battered mind. But one thing is clear - now you are not alone in this hell!

[b]Optimization... or just magic[/b]
You won't believe it, but I improved the game's performance (probably, I hope. Sorry :С ). Now it lags a little less than your life decisions. More FPS, less pointless bugs (I hope). Your processor will breathe a sigh of relief... or not, I'm not an expert.
And maybe I fixed some bugs.

Ready? Then launch it, and let the cat solve your riddles, the fire blaze, and the grass... well, just grow. Good luck in finding Hitler.

P.S. If the cat suddenly tells you something too weird, don't listen to it. Or listen. Your choice.

[u]I'm waiting for your feedback and get ready for even more madness in the future[/u]

Don't forget for mine [url=https://x.com/darklightstudi2]Twitter(X)[/url] :)
